description: Parse YAML (maps, lists, nested indentation, scalars, quoted strings) into JSON with clear error messages.

faqs.a: Indentation-based maps and lists, nesting, strings, numbers, booleans, null, quoted scalars, comments, and simple inline [arrays] and {maps}.
No: anchors/aliases, multi-line block scalars (| and >), tags, or complex keys. The FAQ below explains the limits.
faqs.q: Does it support the full YAML spec?

faqs.a: Tabs are rejected (per the YAML spec) and every error names the offending line number.

howto: Paste your YAML into the input box.
Click Convert to JSON — the parsed result appears formatted.
Copy the JSON or download it as a .json file.
title: YAML to JSON Converter
